title: Application / Controller / Action / Parameter models
meaning: The application model is a tree/graph representing MVC application structure discovered at startup.
ApplicationModel contains controllers and global metadata.
ControllerModel contains action models, controller filters/selectors/properties and controller-level metadata.
ActionModel contains action-specific metadata, selectors, filters, parameters and route/action details.
ParameterModel represents action parameters and carries parameter-level binding/metadata.
boundary_notes: P01 covered the conventions/interfaces that mutate this graph.
R04 covers related metadata model types such as SelectorModel, ApiExplorerModel and BindingInfo.
